'''Krantians''' were a bipedal [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Krant]]. They were [[Color/Legends|pale]]-skinned [[near-Human]]s known for their ultrasound speaking capabilities. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a group of expatriated Krantians protested on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] after their neutral homeworld was the site of a [[Battle of Krant|battle]]. They helped the Rebel Alliance during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
